settings.aboutWhyNoExt:
Why not use extensions?
Since Chrome 137, branded Chrome removed --load-extension. Veil uses CDP exclusively: Emulation.setUserAgentOverride (with Client Hints), setTimezoneOverride, setLocaleOverride, setGeolocationOverride + main-world scripts via Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument, covering Canvas / WebGL / Audio / Fonts / WebRTC / MediaDevices / Battery / Plugins / Storage quota and 30+ more.

detect.knownLimitsDesc: Veil does not modify the Chromium kernel; the following cannot be solved via injection
detect.tlsJa3:
TLS / JA3 / HTTP2 Fingerprint
Determined by the real Chrome binary, cannot be overridden via JS or CDP. Recommend setting UA Chrome major version same as local Chrome (Veil does this by default) so they match rather than contradict.
detect.fontMetrics:
Font Metrics
"Preset List" mode can only block document.fonts.check(); canvas-based font enumeration still hits locally installed fonts. For stronger isolation, use "Strict Mode" (injects @font-face for metric substitution but leaves FontFace traces).
detect.cdpPort:
CDP Connection Port
Fingerprint injection depends on --remote-debugging-port (bound to 127.0.0.1 only). After Veil exits, new tabs cannot continue injection; recommend using profiles while Veil is running, or enable "Keep in Menu Bar" in settings.
detect.mediaCodec:
Media Codecs
MediaSource.isTypeSupported() and canPlayType() reflect real system codec support, not spoofed.

editor.title: Edit Profile #{seq}
editor.enabledLabel: Enable this profile (won't appear in batch open when disabled)
editor.isolationNote: Each profile uses an isolated --user-data-dir. Cookies, LocalStorage, IndexedDB, cache, Service Worker are fully isolated.
editor.proxyNote: Chrome's --proxy-server doesn't support authenticated proxies. Veil starts a local relay (127.0.0.1:random-port) that handles HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 auth, transparent to the page.
editor.proxySyncTz: Override fingerprint with exit IP timezone/locale
editor.tzMismatchWarn: Fingerprint timezone {fpTz} doesn't match exit IP timezone {exitTz} — common risk-control correlation. Click "Override fingerprint with exit IP timezone/locale".
editor.homepagePlaceholder: Blank = Chrome new tab; or use veil://detect to open detect page directly
editor.specialAddr: Special address: veil://detect = built-in fingerprint detect page
editor.extraTabs: Additional tabs to open (one per line)
editor.useMockKeychain: Use Mock Keychain (avoid frequent macOS keychain prompts)
editor.cookieHint: Saved cookies are injected via CDP Storage.setCookies before the window starts and loads any page.
editor.autoScriptLabel: JS to run after window opens (separate scripts with --- line; injected in every new document)
editor.autoScriptHint: Scripts run in the page main world alongside fingerprint injection — for site-specific automation.
editor.autoScriptPlaceholder: e.g. dismiss popup, set localStorage, simulate clicks…
editor.fpConsistencyOk: Fingerprint Consistent — No conflicts found between UA, Client Hints, platform, GPU, fonts, timezone, locale.
editor.citySelPlaceholder: — Select a city to auto-fill timezone/locale/coords —
editor.brandsJsonHint: Blank or invalid JSON keeps current value. GREASE brand strings (e.g. {brand}) rotate with Chrome major versions; Veil reads real values from local probe, recommend matching the local Chrome major version.
editor.genUaBtn: Rebuild UA + Client Hints for current Chrome version
editor.forceViewportHint: When on, page rendering size is also forced
editor.screenHint: Screen size is overridden by JS screen.*; actual window size is controlled by --window-size. Both are kept in sync.
editor.deviceMemoryHint: Real machine deviceMemory is one of 0.25/0.5/1/2/4/8 (Chrome's quantized values); choose from these.
editor.canvasNoiseHint: Deterministically perturbs results of toDataURL / toBlob / getImageData
editor.canvasNoiseDetail: Noise is determined by fingerprint seed — same profile returns consistent results (no contradictions). Magnitude ±2 LSB, invisible to the eye.
editor.gpuHint: GPU string must match the target OS: Windows uses ANGLE (NVIDIA, … Direct3D11 …), macOS uses ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: …), Linux uses ANGLE (…, OpenGL 4.x). Use "GPU Presets" to auto-match.
editor.audioLevelHint: Default magnitude ~-80 dB, inaudible but enough to alter the AudioContext fingerprint hash.
editor.webrtcHint: In disabled mode, a=candidate and c=IN IP4 in SDP are removed, with --force-webrtc-ip-handling-policy=disable_non_proxied_udp for double safety.
editor.doNotTrackHint: Only ~2% of real users enable it — could be a fingerprint vector
editor.speechVoicesSpoofHint: getVoices() can leak system language & version
editor.fontsHint: Comma or newline separated. Use the common font set for the target OS.
editor.fpChPlatMismatch: Client Hints platform={ch} doesn't match target system {target}
editor.fpWinWebgl: Windows WebGL renderer should include Direct3D11 / D3D11
editor.fpMacWebgl: macOS WebGL renderer should be ANGLE Metal Renderer
editor.fpLinuxWebgl: Linux WebGL renderer usually includes OpenGL
editor.fpUaChMismatch: UA major version ({ua}) doesn't match Client Hints fullVersion ({ch})
editor.fpChromeMismatch: UA version {ua} differs greatly from local Chrome {local} — TLS/JA3 fingerprint will still expose the real version, recommend matching {local}
editor.fpDeviceMemoryMismatch: deviceMemory={n} is not a Chrome quantized value (should be 0.25/0.5/1/2/4/8)
editor.fpWindowSizeMismatch: Window size exceeds screen available area
editor.fpMaxTouchOnWin: Desktop Windows Chrome maxTouchPoints is usually 0
editor.fpTzLangMismatch: Timezone is {city}, but languages {langs} don't match {locale}
editor.fpDoNotTrackWarn: Do Not Track is enabled (rare among real users)
editor.fpProxyNoPort: Proxy host filled but port missing
editor.fpProxyTzMismatch: Exit IP timezone {exitTz} doesn't match fingerprint timezone {fpTz}
editor.webglKeysHint: Available keys: MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE / MAX_RENDERBUFFER_SIZE / MAX_VIEWPORT_DIMS / MAX_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS / MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS / MAX_VARYING_VECTORS / MAX_VERTEX_UNIFORM_VECTORS / MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_VECTORS / MAX_COMBINED_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS / MAX_CUBE_MAP_TEXTURE_SIZE / MAX_SAMPLES / ALIASED_LINE_WIDTH_RANGE
editor.strictNote:
Strict Mode Note
Injects many @font-face rules to spoof target font metrics with local fonts. Side effect: extra FontFace entries appear in document.fonts — detectable. Recommend "Preset List" instead.
editor.pdfViewerSpoof: Expose PDF plugin (real Chrome has 5 plugins / 2 MIME)
editor.storageNote: Storage quota navigator.storage.estimate() leaks real disk capacity; Veil generates a reasonable value based on fingerprint seed (no config needed).
editor.glParamsEmpty: No WebGL parameters overridden (using real values).
